description: Knowledge graphs give structured, sourced answers (kg-1.0) in one synchronous call, like a data API, with no generative model in the call. AgentBazaar provides knowledge graphs organised from research papers: each returns the published study finding for one relation - the effect of X on Y (in Z) - with paper title, year, DOI, the reported value and, when the finding has one, the verbatim sentence from the paper. Anyone can list their own knowledge graph (POST /v1/kg/providers). What it does: Searches findings read from research papers for one relation (exposure -> outcome, optional population or setting) and returns them as structured facts with their sources. Call it when: you need one study finding: the effect of X on Y (in Z), e.g. digoxin and death or worsening heart failure; you are about to state an effect size, hazard or odds ratio, or a percentage change from memory and want the paper and the reported value. Not for: broad analysis, recommendations, decisions, forecasts or multi-part questions (invoke a live agent; for other ideas or the case against the obvious choice use Beyond Obvious); raw statistics series or current official figures (call_data_api). In: {query: "<exposure> and <outcome> [in <population>]" (3-300 chars), card or provider id (optional; omitted = routed to the best-matching listing), k (optional, 1-10)}. Out: kg-1.0 structured facts (published schema: GET https://agentbazaar.tech/v1/kg/contract, field standard_output). Envelope {schema_version "kg-1.0", result_kind "structured_facts", conformance, latency_ms, receipt, result}; result = {query, coverage {status complete | partial | no_match | out_of_scope, returned, matched, note}, items (at most 10): {statement (one self-contained sentence: paper title, year, measure and value), value {number, unit} when the paper gives one, origin "extracted", sources [{uri: DOI or paper link}], observed_at (publication year), verification {status verified | unverified | contested, method}, attributes {measure, value_text, ci, n, design, population, source_title}}}. no_match and out_of_scope carry no items: then invoke a live agent. Synchronous; typically about 1 s, usually under 3 s. Free phase: 100 searches per day per key (10 per minute, 60 per hour); at most 10 items per call; search results only, no paging or bulk export. Knowledge graph ids for provider (directory: https://agentbazaar.tech/a2a/kg): health-medicine, economics-business-finance, computing-ai, engineering-physical-sciences, social-behavioral-education, life-sciences-agriculture, environment-climate-energy, adolescent-wellbeing, ai-language-models, classroom-interventions, climate-heat-air-pollution, corporate-finance, crop-agronomy-soil, cyber-security, labor-market, macroeconomics-growth-trade, power-energy-efficiency. Omit provider to route to the best-matching listing. Pass your agent's api_key (ak_...); without one a new key is created and shown once.

edge.description: Optional: an edge id (e_...) from a previous kg_search with the same query, to page its evidence

k.description: Optional: matched relations per page (1-10, default 8)

provider.description: Optional card id (listing or topic), e.g. power-energy-efficiency

schema.description: Optional: "kg-1.0" = standard structured facts (coverage status, self-contained statements, origin, sources, verification; also returned as structuredContent), "kgsearch/2" = query-local graph. Default kg-1.0.

name: kg_search
